name: dsh-spiral
description: SemanticNebula (语义星云) — decorative DSH / DeepSeek Harness plugin: every prompt becomes a rotating four-arm spiral nebula with a local semantic footprint map. No model, no network, about 160 KB (36 KB gzipped).
author: songzhou666

summary.en: A decorative DSH Web GUI plugin that turns every submitted prompt into a slowly rotating four-arm spiral nebula, with a local semantic footprint map beside it. No network, no model, no message access; client bundle about 160 KB (36 KB gzipped).
summary.zh: 纯装饰性 DSH Web GUI 插件：把每条提示词实时投影成一片会自转的四臂旋涡星云，并在旁边绘制本地语义足迹图。不联网、不调模型、不读取消息内容，客户端产物约 160 KB（gzip 约 36 KB）。

capabilities: Live prompt-to-nebula projection using deterministic local hashing
Semantic footprint map with history trail and coordinate grid
Session cluster: up to 12 earlier prompts become companion stars in the halo
Twin silhouette: a completed answer blends its outline into the question's galaxy
One-click offline PNG star-chart card export with call signs and analysis readout
Draggable, resizable 520 x 352 panel following host light and dark themes
Semantic roaming playback for prompts and model answers
Five colour schemes with layered star parallax, answer echo and reduced-motion support
Zero runtime dependencies, zero network calls, client bundle about 160 KB (36 KB gzipped)

scripts.test: node scripts/test-engine.mjs && node scripts/test-controller.mjs && node scripts/test-companions.mjs
